workup.reason_code_summary: The issuer is charging back under Visa 10.5, a transaction flagged under the Visa Fraud Monitoring Program. Under the simplified rules this reason code is non-representable. The only possible route is proof that the issuer miscoded the dispute.
workup.action_justification: Visa 10.5 is non-representable, and nothing in the file shows the issuer miscoded the chargeback.
workup.rationale: Case CB-2025-0010 was raised under Visa 10.5 (Visa Fraud Monitoring Program), which is non-representable under the applicable rules. The transaction record shows AVS Y, CVV M, 3DS authenticated, and matching billing and shipping postcodes. The merchant also supplied a Visa Secure authentication record and a delivery confirmation. None of this evidence shows that the issuer miscoded the dispute, so it does not change the outcome. Liability for GBP 78.50 is accepted.
caveats: The transaction has strong authentication indicators: 3DS authenticated (ECI 05), full AVS match, CVV match, a signed delivery to the billing postcode, and a returning customer. If the merchant believes the issuer should have used a standard fraud code (e.g. 10.4) instead of 10.5, check whether a miscoding argument or an issuer inquiry is available before closing.
The 3DS authentication timestamp (22:14:51 UTC) precedes the transaction timestamp (22:14:55 UTC), which is consistent.
The merchant may be enrolled in or approaching VFMP thresholds; flag the account to risk and monitoring teams, since further 10.5 chargebacks are likely.

rule_text:
Visa 10.5 - Visa Fraud Monitoring Program
Issuer claim: Transaction flagged under Visa's fraud monitoring program.
Logic: This reason code is not representable under the simplified rules.
Note: This reason code generally cannot be represented. Recommend accept_liability unless the merchant can prove the transaction was miscoded by the issuer.
prechecks: Representable under the rule: NO (forced accept_liability)
AVS: Y (full address match); CVV: M (match); 3DS: authenticated
Chargeback raised 15 days after the transaction
Flag: Visa 10.5 is non-representable: evidence does not change the outcome
